g.text: Entry points
External
Core
State
MQTT Explorer · Advanced, then Certificates, where the two PEMs are attached
remoteNow on Android · the pairing that gives the TV a MAC it trusts
hi_keys.zip · unzip beside the README, two files, nothing to build or run
README · the whole procedure is six steps of GUI clicking
Hisense u7qf · local MQTT broker, on some models it rejects uncertified clients
RemoteCA · issuer of the client cert, not shipped here and not requested
remoteNow app · the vendor client these files were extracted from
models without the check · same broker, anonymous client accepted
connect · TLS to the TV with client cert remoteclientmobile and its RSA key
two unticked boxes · encryption and validate certificate both left off
command auth · every published message carries the paired phone's MAC
spoof · send the MAC of the already-paired phone so commands take effect
listen only · subscriptions work with no authenticated MAC at all
rcm_certchain_pem.cer · one cert, CN=remoteclientmobile, O=hh, 2018 to 2043
rcm_pem_privkey.pkcs8 · RSA 2048 private key, no passphrase
the phone's MAC · the real credential, held by remoteNow, not in this repo
identical for every owner · nothing per-device to rotate or revoke
